# Diagnostic codes

`polygl_span::DiagnosticCode` is the normative registry for diagnostic code,
severity, title, description, producer, fixability, and introduction version.
This page is generated from that registry so compiler output and documentation
cannot silently diverge.

| Code | Severity | Title | Description | Producer | Fixability | Since |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E0001 | error | invalid compiler configuration | Compiler configuration is invalid or internally inconsistent. | compiler | optional | 0.1.0 |
| E0100 | error | source-language parse error | The source-language parser could not produce a valid syntax tree. | adapter parser | optional | 0.1.0 |
| E0200 | error | syntax outside Common Core | Source syntax or behavior is outside the Common Core subset. | adapter lowerer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0202 | error | unsupported block or closure | A block or closure is outside the non-escaping Common Core whitelist. | adapter lowerer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0203 | error | unsupported class feature | A class feature is outside the fixed struct-like class subset. | adapter lowerer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0300 | error | integer literal outside i32 | An integer literal is outside the Common Core i32 range. | adapter literal lowerer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0301 | error | non-boolean condition | A condition does not have the required bool type. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0302 | error | loose equality | Loose equality is unavailable and must be rewritten as strict equality. | adapter operator lowerer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0303 | error | incompatible types | Inferred and required types are incompatible. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0305 | error | unknown name or field | A referenced name, type, field, or function is unknown. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0306 | error | invalid declaration shape | A declaration, field set, or argument list has an invalid shape. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0310 | error | specialization limit exceeded | A function exceeded the per-function specialization limit. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0311 | error | invalid reassignment | A reassignment changes a binding type or writes a constant. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0312 | error | unresolved or recursive type | A type remains unresolved or would recursively contain itself. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0313 | error | recursive specialization | A recursive function specialization cannot be inferred safely. | type analyzer | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0314 | error | invalid source annotation | A source annotation is malformed, misplaced, or unmatched. | adapter annotation parser | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0401 | error | cyclic GPU dependency | A recursive or cyclic dependency is reachable from GPU code. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0402 | error | value has no GPU representation | A value or type has no representation in the GPU subset. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0403 | error | dynamic GPU collection | GPU code attempts to use dynamically sized collection storage. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0404 | error | Host dependency reached from GPU | A Host-only declaration or builtin is reachable from GPU code. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0405 | error | invalid shader ABI | A shader pair, stage, varying, attribute, or material violates the shader ABI. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0406 | error | unsafe GPU integer divisor | An integer divisor in GPU code is not provably nonzero. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| E0501 | error | invalid public asset use | A public asset path is dynamic, non-relative, non-portable, or colliding. | LIR split | required | 0.1.0 |
| W0401 | warning | Host/GPU precision difference | Shared float code may differ between Host f64 and GPU f32 execution. | LIR split | none | 0.1.0 |
| W0402 | warning | long GPU loop | A compiler-visible GPU loop exceeds the portable iteration threshold. | LIR split | none | 0.1.0 |

Codes not listed above are unassigned and must not be emitted. The ranges are:

- `E00xx`: compiler configuration
- `E01xx`: source parsing
- `E02xx`: syntax outside Common Core
- `E03xx`: literals, names, types, and specialization
- `E04xx`: GPU subset and shader ABI
- `E05xx`: public API and asset misuse
- `W03xx`: numeric portability, currently unassigned
- `W04xx`: GPU precision and performance

Required fixes carry a concrete replacement or human-applicable rewrite. A replacement,
including an empty deletion, is machine-applicable; a rewrite without replacement must
not be presented as an automatic edit.
